blurb: YogaSix provides six signature yoga classes and three specialty classes focusing on strength, agility, flexibility, and balance. Classes range from foundational to heated and restorative styles, including sculpt and core strength classes. The studio emphasizes a safe, sanitized environment and a community experience.
